title: Count Operator
description: Learn to count elements in collections using the Count operator.

data.text: The `Count` operator returns the number of elements in a collection or the number of elements that satisfy a given condition.
The `Count()` extension method has two overloads:

data.title: Count Method Signatures
Count Examples
Count with Complex Types
Query Syntax Limitation
data.text: C# query syntax doesn't directly support aggregation operators. Wrap the query in brackets and call Count() on the result.

data.title: Count in Query Syntax
data.code:
var totalAge = (from s in studentList
                 select s.Age).Count();

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Count returns the number of elements in a collection
Two overloads: with and without predicate
Not directly supported in C# query syntax
Useful for counting elements matching a condition
data.takeaway: Continue to the next lesson to learn about the Sum operator.
